answer: Weight is earned, not claimed: an identity accrues voting power only through sustained activity streaks certified by a quorum of peers each week. The streak must survive a long verification horizon, and any gap beyond a short grace window resets it to zero. For a Sybil attacker the voyage is brutal — every fake identity must stay continuously active with plausibly distinct behavior, multiplying operator and compute cost per identity, while synchronized activity creates a ripple that correlation detectors flag. Honest users pay with time they already spend; attackers pay per fake, every week.
